structure_strategy.container_policy: Cards are for modular comparisons or evidence groups, not the default way to make prose look designed.
structure_strategy.rhythm_break_plan: Use a rhythm break only when the content asks for it: a true hero metric, a full-bleed/source-backed image, a major section turn, or a decisive chart.
